notes.title: Small Fix - QoL and Dispensers
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

Some of you reported a couple of issues, so here's the fix:
- Stackers and Gluers: When the machine rejects an input many times, it will clear all its content so belts won't get stuck. 
- Dispensers: Now, loading a save will set the correct u/m for them, as this was failing in some cases.

notes.title: New automation sandbox game Block Factory is basically Satisfactory with Lego
notes.content:
I love it when a plan comes together, and there are few more fulfilling videogame implementations of that than the likes of Satisfactory and Factorio. Watching your carefully placed construction line whirr into action to make products and materials is the ultimate culmination of hours of effort. In one of the most logical connections ever made, relaxing new sandbox game Block Factory takes that concept and infuses it with Lego-style building blocks, tasking you with manufacturing all manner of figurines to your heart's content, and it's yours for just $10.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Fixing Block Factory Optimization
notes.content: [p][/p][h3]Hello Block Builders![/h3][p][/p][p]We are aware that some users are experiencing issues with the game’s optimization. Ironically, these optimization issues seem to be happening to those who are working on optimizing their factories to achieve the highest scores, while more casual builders aren’t experiencing any trouble.[/p][p][/p][p]Our objective has always been giving the best of both worlds to our hardcore and casual audience, with easy initial objectives to jump straight to the next level and hard enough challenges to scratch that itch in your brain for those who want to optimize. We are very sad that we are currently delivering only the best of one world, and hope to bring the best of the other world to our optimizers. [/p][p][/p][p]We are working hard on identifying the issues, and we are super thankful for all your feedback in the Steam Discussions and our Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]As we have mentioned in the past, [i]we are a tiny studio of 5 developers[/i]. Our two programmers have been reviewing all the issues since launch, tweaking and testing all the intricacies of the code. Meanwhile, both artists are trying to figure out if there is anything on the graphical side of the game (3D models, animations, VFX…) that could be improved, and our designer is testing each save we are being sent to relay any useful information to the rest of the team while he thinks on solutions to iterate faster on a fix.[/p][p][/p][h2]Optimization Band-Aid[/h2][p][/p][p]We have just released an update that fixes small issues we’ve found that affected performance in minor ways, as well as tweaked the balance on machine efficiency. [b]Furthermore, if you have 3* starred a figurine you can now delete or lower it’s production without loosing the score.[/b] This is not a permanent solution but rather a small temporal band-aid to make the game as enjoyable as possible for those who want to optimize.[/p][p][/p][h2]Your help is being valuable[/h2][p][/p][p]As you can imagine, [b][u]it’s being an exhausting weekend[/u][/b]. Sadly, these kind of situations some time happen are part of game development and we are the first who want to fix this and bring you the best version of Block Factory for you to enjoy. As of now, [b]we are still working hard and we will let you know as soon as we have an estimated date for the update[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]If you’d like to help us out with this issue please send us your save files zipped to [/p][p][url="https://support@overpoweredteam.com"]support@overpoweredteam.com[/url][/p][p]To find the saves folder follow this route: C:\\Users\\YOUR_USERNAME_HERE\\AppData\\LocalLow\\OverPowered Team\\Block Factory[/p][p][/p][p]We really appreciate all your patience and support and are extremely sorry for not being able to deliver Block Factory at it’s peak yet. <3[/p]

notes.title: What’s Waiting for You in Block Factory
notes.content:
[p]Hello Block fans,[/p][p][/p][p]Today we want to give you an overview of what you can expect to see in the full version of Block Factory once it releases on July 11![/p][p][/p][h3]Learn the Ropes[/h3][p]Your journey begins with the Tutorial. It’s a quick and friendly introduction that teaches you the basics, from using the different controls to understanding how Block Factory works. It’s designed to get you up to speed without overwhelming you, so you can jump straight into the rest of the game with confidence.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131089/1b00efdf6d229c31e8f91c134551f7d8ae131d0c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Explore the Archipelagos[/h3][p]The world of Block Factory is made up of five Archipelagos. Each Archipelago contains several Islands, and on each Island, you’ll find Dioramas built around a specific theme. For example, a Diorama set in a farm environment might ask you to deliver a scarecrow figurine.[/p][p]To complete a Diorama, you’ll need to deliver the correct figurine using the different pieces available to you. As you progress, you’ll earn blocks by completing Dioramas. These blocks let you unlock new Islands and gradually expand your journey across the Archipelagos.[/p][p]There’s plenty to uncover along the way, with a total of 24 Islands and 75 figurines to discover and build. The figurines start out simple and only take a few minutes to complete, but as you unlock new Islands, they’ll grow in size and complexity, requiring more planning and precision.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131089/f85b85ea06660907334461124ebcac95c2d33288.png"][/img][/p][h3]Optional Goals, Earn Rewards[/h3][p]Each Diorama sets a specific objective, usually requiring you to deliver the figurine at a certain rate measured in units per minute. When you hit those goals, you’ll earn coins, which can then be used to upgrade your machines or unlock entirely new ones.[/p][p]Upgrades might boost performance, like increasing the stacking speed to x1.5. New machines, such as the Stacker 3.0, open up new possibilities by letting you combine more parts at once. These enhancements are key to keeping up as the figurines become bigger and more demanding.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131089/0e500277163596e53ee66aeaf830570258baa098.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Create and Share[/h3][p]For players who want to go off the beaten path, Creative Mode offers a space to build whatever you like. The Editor gives you access to every block in the game, so you can design your own figurines from scratch. You can also create custom Dioramas using one of 21 layout presets, and decorate them with any of the 55 available props to match the look and feel you’re going for.[/p][p]Once you’re happy with your creation, you can share it on the Steam Workshop for others to enjoy, or browse the community’s creations and try building someone else’s design.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131089/4f99bc7956c841c3ffe12e50d13467bf46f793ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Whether you’re aiming for production efficiency or expressing your creativity, Block Factory gives you the tools to make it happen. We can’t wait to see what you build next![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: ROAD TO RELEASE
notes.content:
Hello Block fans,

Block Factory was initially introduced to you back in late August, when we launched our first Playtest. We gathered [b]tons of valuable insights from the community[/b] which helped shape the game to something more suited to your expectations!

[h3]What we achieved together[/h3]

We [b]worked hard[/b] on refining the onboarding process, to help you learn the specifics of our game more smoothly. We also improved some aspects of the User Interface, to be more in-line with similar games of the genre and [b]reduce friction[/b].

The addition of the Challenge Mode also offered another flavour to the game, players now have to scratch their heads and [b]optimize[/b] their [b]production[/b] and [b]workflow[/b] to reach new goals.

Things got more serious for Block Factory during the Steam Next Fest last October. We got [b]a big influx of new players[/b] and even content creators took some time to try the game out. The community also contributed in its own way, by submitting their own creations to the Steam workshop. 
This phase really helped us to [b]gather feedback[/b] and helped us to have a [b]clearer perspective[/b] on the road ahead.

[h3]The Road Ahead[/h3]

So what’s next for Block Factory? To be fully transparent with you, we initially envisioned an Early Access phase, to continue improving the game.
But thanks to all the feedback we have received, we feel more confident to work on what we already know, solidify the basics, create more levels to get ready for [b]a full release in early 2025[/b].


We cannot wait to show you the final version of Block Factory! See you very soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827680/Block_Factory/

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
First of all, we wanted to thank all of you who joined us to play the Demo during the Steam Next Fest.
We have seen a substantial influx of players and even more feedback on Discord and Feature Upvote.

We have dedicated our efforts to  bug fixing and to also overhaul one of our core systems: the Units Calculations System. It would not have been possible if not for your feedback. We have worked very hard on this and it has proven to be quite challenging from a development perspective!

So let's hear what you think about it, and let us know if some additional tweaking is required! 


[h3]Main Fix: u/m calculations rework [/h3]
[list][*] All units per minute (u/m) calculations are fixed and should be displayed correctly.[/list]
[h3]Fixes [/h3]
[list][*]Bugs while loading
[*] Random rotations in output items
[*] Gluer and Stacker not recognizing input
[*] Right click mass delete freezing
[*] Bug Conveyor + Teleporter[/list]
[h3]Improvements [/h3]
[list][*] Conveyor anchors: Now you can press "[b]C[/b]" while building a conveyor to place an anchor and make as many corners as you need.
[*] Star Goals Display: Any completed figure will show the stars required units per minute (u/m) when hovering.
[*] Re-assign figurine in compass at end of level.
[*] Paste over conveyors
[*] Undo recovers machine configuration[/list]

Thank you all for your involvement and feedback over these last two weeks, we'll be back soon, to have a look at your latest creations, we had quite some fun, but some of you really need to get better at this ngl).

If you want to to continue discussing all things Block Factory, come and see us on our Discord server!

notes.title: Creative Mode has been added to the demo!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have now added Creative mode to the Block Factory demo. This feature gives you the opportunity to design and build your own figurines. 

You can upload your masterpieces to the Steam workshop so that other players can try their hand at building them. Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/bWZspKPmhb]discord[/url] and share screenshots of your creations!

notes.title: Block Factory Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce that the Block Factory demo is now available for you to download and play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131089/ba45738a3d0fcfb3244afc2b732aee5316e09dd9.gif[/img]

In this demo, you’ll have access to the first two levels, Ocean and Farm, from the Pioneers Land archipelago - just one of the many level groups featured in the final game. Each level includes four unique figurines with varying shapes, sizes, and colours for you to construct using an array of machines.

The figurines in this demo are simpler compared to those in later levels, so you can expect more complex and challenging builds in the full version of the game.

For those who participated in the playtest, we’ve implemented several changes based on your feedback. We focused on quality of life improvements, most notably revamped keybinds and hotkeys.

Additionally, we’re excited to announce that the Creative Mode will be added to the demo in a future update. The figurine editor that will allow you to design and build your own creations. You’ll also be able to share them with friends and fellow block enthusiasts. So stay tuned!

You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/bWZspKPmhb]Discord[/url] to discuss your ideas with us and other players!

Don’t forget to wishlist Block Factory if you enjoy your time playing the demo!

notes.title: Block Factory Playtest Update #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We have now released our first major update for the Block Factory playtest. This update is shaped by the feedback and suggestions you’ve shared on Feature Upvote (our public board). It brings a number of major changes to the game thanks to the insights we’ve gathered since the playtest began!

Invites have been sent to all who have applied to participate, don’t forget to request access if you haven’t already! 

Save files have been wiped and all progress has been reset. 

Check out the full changelist here:

[h3]New content[/h3]
[list][*] New level: Dinner
[*] New figurines: 
[list][*] Tuna Sushi
[*] Omelette Sushi 
[*] Egg[/list]
[*] New machines: 
[list][*] Rounder. Use a Rounder to modify pieces and give them a smooth finish. 
[*] Bleacher. Paint any block white without dyes. 
[*] Burner. Paint any block black without dyes. 
[*] Double Cutter. This machine allows you to keep both sides of a cut figure, enabling recycling of materials. It must be unlocked through the Upgrades Menu.[/list][/list]

[h3]User Interface & Usability Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] The tutorial now has a button to better guide you through the steps.
[*] Added visual Hotkeys throughout the UI to help you navigate the game with more ease.
[*] If you click on the side panel "Complete Diorama" when you deliver all the figurines, it will now open the Diorama Window instead of centering the Diorama on screen.
[*] Added a Top View (Hotkey "T") feature to give a new perspective to the game, letting you see all machines properly without them hiding behind others.
[*] Dragging the camera with the mouse will now more accurately keep the floor under the mouse in place.
[*] Camera rotation now follows your mouse instead of setting a constant rotating speed.[/list]

[h3]Machine & Conveyor Mechanics[/h3]
[list][*] Machine speed is now represented in Units Per Second (u/s) to calculate optimal machine placement more easily.
[*] Most machine speeds have been tweaked to align with Piece and Dye Dispensers output speeds (1 u/s).
[*] Conveyors now behave more smoothly.
[*] Conveyors auto-connect to machines and other conveyors when placed adjacent to them.
[*] Teleporters now have a brief delay when receiving a piece for the first time, matching the time it takes a conveyor to move that piece from TP-input to TP-output.
[*] Subsequent pieces are teleported at the same rate as a conveyor (4 u/s).
[*] When making a big selection, the Machine Actions menu now appears on screen, even if the selection area was previously off-screen.[/list]

[h3]Upgrades & Machines[/h3]
[list][*] The Upgrade System of the Island Menu has been improved with the following changes:
[list][*] Added visual representation for each unlockable machine.
[*] Easier navigation and understanding of the upgrade section.
[*] Upgrade costs have been tweaked so you can upgrade more items.[/list][/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes & Performance[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed several reported minor bugs and softlock issues.[/list]


Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions, we can't wait to hear your thoughts and feedback on this update!

notes.title: The Block Factory Playtest is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we’re excited to announce that [b]the Block Factory playtest is live[/b]! 

In last week’s blog post we shared what content is available in the playtest. Since then, we have decided to add the following features: 
[list][*] [b]Challenge Mode[/b]: Once you have completed an Island/Level in the Campaign Mode, you will be able to play it in the Challenge Mode. In this mode, speed is key! You will have to deliver a certain amount of each figurine as fast as you can to get a star rank. If you want 3 stars, you will need to optimise your factory!
[*] [b]Tech Tree / Upgrade System[/b]: After delivering the first unit of a figurine, your factory will continue to produce more units that will be stored. After delivering X units of a figurine, you will be rewarded with a coin. Coins are used in the Archipelago Menu to buy new machines, upgrade mechanics or improve your production speed.[/list]
[h3]Bug reports, Feedback and Suggestions[/h3]
We’ve set up a public bug tracker and suggestions board, [url=https://blockfactory-feedback-cblfjg8p.featureupvote.com]Feature Upvote[/url], that allows you to submit any issues you might be experiencing, or suggestions you might like to see added or changed, and vote on them as a community. This gives us a clearer view of how prevalent each issue or idea is and prioritise accordingly.

We love to involve the community in our development, we value all suggestions and feedback as we work together to build a better game.

You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/bWZspKPmhb]Discord[/url] to discuss your ideas with us and other players! 


[h3]Content Creators[/h3] 
You are free to live stream, record and share videos of the playtest. We would appreciate it if you mention that the build you are playing is a playtest / beta version of Block Factory. Please get in touch with us if you have any questions or requests via [url=https://x.com/BlockFactory__]Twitter / X[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.gg/bWZspKPmhb]Discord[/url] server.   


[h3]Haven’t signed up yet?[/h3] 
For those of you who haven’t signed up yet, don’t worry you haven’t missed out. The playtest will run until September 2nd so don’t forget to request access by signing up on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827680/Block_Factory/

If you have any questions don’t hesitate to share them in the comments and we’ll try our best to answer them all.

notes.title: Block Factory Playtest Preview!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’ve been hard at work preparing the Block Factory playtest, and we’re excited to share with you what kind of content you can expect once you gain access.

Let’s dive right in!

In the playtest, you’ll be able to explore the first three levels (Islands) of the Pioneers Land archipelago - one of several archipelagos that will be featured in the final version of the game.

Below, you can see a sneak peek of one of the Islands that will be available in the playtest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131089/f85b85ea06660907334461124ebcac95c2d33288.png[/img]
[i]This Diorama has four figurines: Pumpkin, Bluebird, Crow and Scarecrow[/i]

The three Islands included in the playtest are: Ocean, Farm, and Pond. Ocean and Farm each feature four figurines, while Pond offers two, all varying in shapes, sizes, and colors for you to build using a wide array of machines.

Here’s a glimpse of some of the figurines from the different Islands: the Turtle from Ocean Island, the Crow from Farm Island, and the Frog from Pond Island. 

[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131089/5681fc86ef9b57052de585d08166ef3cc7e684be.png[/img][/th]

[i]The scale is different in-game[/i]

The figurines available in the playtest are simpler than those found in later levels; expect more challenging content in the full game.

As mentioned earlier, you’ll have access to several machines (because what’s a factory without its machines?) that will become available as you progress. Each machine plays a unique role, allowing you to advance from constructing small figurines to larger, more complex ones that will challenge your puzzle-solving skills!

We can’t wait to open up this playtest to you and would love to hear your thoughts on what we’ve shared in this post. Don’t forget to sign up for the playtest and wishlist Block Factory if you haven't already!

notes.title: Block Factory FAQ
notes.content:
[quote]Hello everyone! 

We've received a few questions from you since we announced Block Factory last week, so we thought it would be a good idea to answer them here. 
Feel free to share any other questions you might have in the comments and we'll get back to you as soon as possible![/quote] 

[h3]What is Block Factory?[/h3]
Block Factory is a production and automation game focusing on creating 3D figurines from building blocks in a factory. Shape your models, design and optimize your assembly lines to bring your creations to life! Developed by OverPowered Team and published by Shiro Unlimited. 

[h3]When is the Early Access release date?[/h3]
Q4 2024

[h3]Will there be a demo?[/h3]
Yes, in a couple of months and we’re also planning a playtest so stay tuned! 

[h3]Where can I stay up to date with the latest news? [/h3]
Steam, [url=https://discord.gg/bWZspKPmhb]Discord[/url], [url=https://x.com/BlockFactory__]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/BlockFactory/]Reddit[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@blockfactorygame?lang=en]TikTok[/url]. 

[h3]What were your inspirations?[/h3]
Of course, top-tier automation games like Shapez and Factorio are among our inspirations. However, we also aimed to appeal to a broader audience, so we drew inspiration from other management games like Dorfromantik and Mini Metro.

[h3]Will it have multiplayer or co-op features?[/h3]
Not at EA launch.

[h3]What are the minimum and recommended system specs to run Block Factory?[/h3]
[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]Minimum:[/th]
[th]Recommended:[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]OS: Windows 10 64bit[/td]
[td]OS: Windows 10 64bit[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-4440 CPU[/td]
[td]Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700 CPU[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Memory: 4 GB RAM[/td]
[td]Memory: 8 GB RAM[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Graphics: Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630, 1GB VRAM[/td]
[td]Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Storage: 2 GB available space[/td]
[td]Storage: 2 GB available space[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h3]What languages will be supported?[/h3]
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain), Galician, Russian, Simplified Chinese

[h3]Will mods be supported?[/h3]
No plans for mod support.

[h3]Will Steam Deck or controllers be supported?[/h3]
No plans at this moment in time, but we are open to exploring this depending on the demand. 


[h3]Will there be achievements?[/h3]
Yes. 

[h3]Can I join a playtest?[/h3]
Yes but your access will not be guaranteed.

[h3]How can I support the development of Block Factory?[/h3]
You can support us by wishlisting the game on Steam, signing up for the playtest and following us on social media.

notes.title: Introducing Block Factory | Sign up for the playtest now!

Hello everyone! 

[previewyoutube=A6yGmc7HOsU;full][/previewyoutube]

We are thrilled to have announced Block Factory, a new game from OverPowered Team & Shiro Unlimited. You can wishlist now on Steam and sign up for the playtest!

Block Factory is a production and automation game focused on creating 3D figurines from building blocks. Shape your models, design, and optimize your assembly lines to bring your creations to life!

[list][*] Plan and refine your factory layouts and assembly lines for maximum efficiency.
[*] Build and utilize machines to gather, transform, stack, glue, and assemble blocks into charming figurines.
[*] Overcome complex logistics and automate processes from cutting and shaping to painting and mixing colors.
[*] Unlock new technologies and expand your factory's capabilities to enhance production.
[*] Assemble figurines and place them in evolving dioramas that showcase your growing skills.[/list]
Stay tuned for more updates, and join us on our social media and forums.
